# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering fixes and platform alignment**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.156.0 release improves rendering correctness and updates Apple and Uno platform requirements. Changes include display-paced Android texture rendering, native callback fixes, and more reliable Linux text shaping alongside same-milestone Skia m156 fixes. Review the Apple deployment floors, Uno 7 migration, and custom WebAssembly archive requirements before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, preserving any higher framework or application minimum. These floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native baselines in this development line and support Xcode 27 builds; .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno integrations to Uno 7** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now targets Uno 7, with .NET 10 required for its non-Windows assembly. Migrate pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines to the .NET SDK WebAssembly path. On non-Windows Uno, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses CPU rendering, reports a null GRContext, and removes RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU** — Newer WebAssembly consumers expect emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling it during application linking. Upgrade to matching rebuilt native assets, or rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; older and GPU-disabled custom archives do not meet this contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 correctness updates** — Reject overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, budget region storage for subdivided conics, and prevent execution of partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines. Graphite fixes preserve hairline and subpixel stroke bounds and compare complete paint keys. These updates stay on m156 without changing managed APIs or the native ABI. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, is paced by display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and pause, resize, reattachment, and render-mode transitions preserve progress. This does not cap every RequestRender call or guarantee presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native boolean callbacks match their ABI** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, while public managed signatures remain bool. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter return-value handling and HarfBuzz false-returning callbacks, including glyph-name callbacks. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicting system symbols** — Bundled HarfBuzz calls bind to their own implementation, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. The fix applies to the common Linux link recipe, including nodeps, without changing exported entry points or managed signatures. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **String conversion and validation corrected** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit: ASCII for UTF-8, one UTF-16 unit, or a full UTF-32 code point. Use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. GetString now throws ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays, and FromCString fixes a native buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Ganesh GLES uploads corrected** — Ganesh GL disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertised GL_RGBA, a configuration invalid in GLES. Readback is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **WebAssembly links accept application C sources** — Application links no longer compile the WebGPU port source or pass its C++ standard flag to application C sources. The required JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools the UTF-32 encoding buffer for AddUtf32 string calls and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention fix** — Fixes front-buffered stream retention. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Windows dependencies aligned** — WinUI, MAUI, and Uno library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. Bundled WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118, with matching PDB names for its shipped DLLs. These updates do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
